form.label: Velociraptor endpoint and DFIR telemetry - Overview
form.description: Fixture-backed overview for Velociraptor monitoring, hunt lifecycle, and artifact-result JSON/JSONL relay rows. Panels use fields proven by synthetic-equivalent fixtures and Splunk props; this dashboard is not replay/read-back validation.

search.query: index=oswinsec (sourcetype="velociraptor:monitoring:json" OR sourcetype="velociraptor:hunt:json" OR sourcetype="velociraptor:artifact:result:json") host=$host_tok$ | stats count
index=oswinsec (sourcetype="velociraptor:monitoring:json" OR sourcetype="velociraptor:hunt:json" OR sourcetype="velociraptor:artifact:result:json") host=$host_tok$ | timechart count by sourcetype

index=oswinsec (sourcetype="velociraptor:monitoring:json" OR sourcetype="velociraptor:hunt:json" OR sourcetype="velociraptor:artifact:result:json") host=$host_tok$ | stats count by action Artifact artifact signature sourcetype | sort -count

index=oswinsec (sourcetype="velociraptor:hunt:json" OR sourcetype="velociraptor:monitoring:json") host=$host_tok$ (state=* OR result=* OR Mutation.state=*) | stats count by sourcetype state result Mutation.state | sort -count

index=oswinsec sourcetype="velociraptor:monitoring:json" host=$host_tok$ | stats count latest(CPUPercent) as latest_cpu latest(MemoryRSS) as latest_memory values(OS) as os values(User) as users values(Artifact) as artifacts values(marker) as markers by Hostname ClientId host source | sort -count

index=oswinsec sourcetype="velociraptor:hunt:json" host=$host_tok$ | table _time host sourcetype source vendor product Artifact hunt_id HuntId state result Creator user Description Created action signature signature_id marker _raw | sort -_time | head 100

index=oswinsec sourcetype="velociraptor:artifact:result:json" host=$host_tok$ | table _time host sourcetype source vendor product Artifact ClientId client_id Hostname hunt_id HuntId FlowId flow_id ArtifactRow.ProcessName ArtifactRow.Pid ArtifactRow.Rule ArtifactRow.Hit Executable Binary Hash RunCount PrefetchFileName ExecutionTime action signature signature_id marker _raw | sort -_time | head 100

index=oswinsec (sourcetype="velociraptor:monitoring:json" OR sourcetype="velociraptor:hunt:json" OR sourcetype="velociraptor:artifact:result:json") host=$host_tok$ | stats count dc(marker) as fixture_markers values(vendor) as vendors values(product) as products min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by index sourcetype source host | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort -count

panel.title: Artifact-specific triage: network sockets, services, YARA hits, and Prefetch execution

search.query: index=oswinsec sourcetype="velociraptor:artifact:result:json" host=$host_tok$ (Artifact="Windows.Network.Netstat" OR Artifact="Windows.System.Services" OR Artifact="Windows.Detection.Yara.Process" OR Artifact="Windows.Forensics.Prefetch") | table _time host sourcetype source Artifact Hostname ClientId Pid Name ProcessName Executable Binary Rule Laddr.IP Laddr.Port Raddr.IP Raddr.Port Status State StartMode PathName ExePath ExecutablePath ExecutableDosPath CommandLine Hash RunCount PrefetchFileName ExecutionTime action signature signature_id marker _raw | sort -_time | head 100

index=oswinsec (sourcetype="velociraptor:monitoring:json" OR sourcetype="velociraptor:hunt:json" OR sourcetype="velociraptor:artifact:result:json") host=$host_tok$ | table _time host sourcetype source vendor product Artifact artifact ClientId client_id Hostname user hunt_id HuntId FlowId flow_id action signature signature_id marker _raw | sort -_time | head 50
